# First-Run Observation Sheet

**Participant:** ______ (persona: upgrader / programmer / writer / beginner / accessibility)   **Date:** ______   **Device/keyboard/layout:** ______

## Rules
Do not explain. Do not help unless they are stuck for over a minute. Record what they do and say.

## Tasks and observations
| # | Task | Completed unaided? (Y/N) | Time | Hesitations / errors | Quotes | Severity (1-4) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Land on the site; what do they think it is? (5-second impression) | | | | | |
| 2 | Take a typing test | | | | | |
| 3 | Read the results; what do they think the numbers mean? | | | | | |
| 4 | Find what to work on ("What to fix") | | | | | |
| 5 | Start the practice from the weak spots | | | | | |
| 6 | Finish the drill and retest; see if they improved | | | | | |
| 7 | (If prompted) save progress / set a goal | | | | | |
| 8 | Programmers: try the baseline or Level 1 | | | | | |

## Questions after
- What did you expect to happen?
- What was confusing?
- Would you use this tomorrow? What would make you?
- What would you tell a friend it is?
- Single Ease Question per task (1-7): ______

| Issue | Frequency (n of participants) | Severity | Fix idea | Ticket |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Trust and comfort
- Did they worry about data or cheating? What did they say?
- Did any copy feel pushy or guilt-inducing?
